title: ForumScoringEvents
description: Forum events consumed by Contributions & Scoring (Unit 7) for auto-award (US-6.4, DL17). AUTHORED AHEAD OF THE PRODUCER (dormant-consumer pattern, DL10): Forums is still a mock, so Unit 7 builds its consumer against this contract now and it stays dormant (0 messages) until Forums is built. A forum channel always belongs to exactly one group (DL7), so `groupId` is always present. `authorRole` is stamped by Forums at action time (DL8) so Unit 7 needs no role projection. Reply points are awarded ONLY when a reply is accepted as the answer (US-4.15) and are REVERSED on un-accept — the toggle carries `accepted`. `postDate` is the ORIGINAL post/reply creation date and sets the scoring quarter (DL17).

ForumPostCreated.description: A member created a forum post (+1, single-group, uncapped). earnedDate = postDate.

postDate.description: ISO date the post was created; sets the quarter

ReplyAccepted.description: A reply's accepted-answer state changed (US-4.15). `accepted=true` awards +2 to the reply author; `accepted=false` (un-accept / accepted-answer changed away) reverses -2. Both land in the quarter of the reply's ORIGINAL postDate (DL17). The consumer toggles per-reply state so redelivery of either transition is a no-op.

postDate.description: ISO date the REPLY was originally posted; sets the quarter
